name: TC_PLT_API_USER_01 Verify that regular User can retrieve paginated list of plants via API
fullName: TC_PLT_API_USER_01 Verify that regular User can retrieve paginated list of plants via API

steps.name: Given User "testuser" is authenticated with password "test123"
request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/auth/login', body: { username: 'testuser', password: 'test123' }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
assert expected **200** to equal **200**
Given At least 4 plants exist in the database
request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/auth/login', body: { username: 'admin', password: 'admin123' }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
wrap Object{4}, Object{4}, Object{4}, Object{4}

request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/plants/category/2', body: { name: 'Fern', price: 20, quantity: 10, category: [Object] }, auth: { bearer: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiI'... 121 more characters }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
log Plant Fern likely already exists (Status 400). Proceeding.

request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/plants/category/2', body: { name: 'Bamboo', price: 30, quantity: 15, category: [Object] }, auth: { bearer: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiI'... 121 more characters }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
log Plant Bamboo likely already exists (Status 400). Proceeding.

request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/plants/category/2', body: { name: 'Money Plant', price: 15, quantity: 20, category: [Object] }, auth: { bearer: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiI'... 121 more characters }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
log Plant Money Plant likely already exists (Status 400). Proceeding.

request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/plants/category/2', body: { name: 'Spider Plant', price: 25, quantity: 12, category: [Object] }, auth: { bearer: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiI'... 121 more characters }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
log Plant Spider Plant likely already exists (Status 400). Proceeding.
assert expected **200** to equal **200**
When I send a GET request to "/api/plants/paged" with parameters:
request ("{ method: 'GET', url: '/api/plants/paged', qs: { page: '0', size: '10' }, auth: { bearer: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ0ZXN0dXN'... 124 more characters }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
Then The response status code should be 200
assertexpected 200 to equal 200
assert expected **200** to equal **200**
And The response body should contain an array of plants
assertexpected 10 to be at least 2
assert expected **10** to be at least **2**
And The response should include pagination metadata:

DataTable

| pageNumber    |
| totalElements |
| offset        |
| sort          |

assertExpected response to have property sort (checked top-level 'sort' or body.pageable.sort): expected true to be true
assertExpected response to have property size (checked top-level 'size' or body.pageable.size): expected true to be true
